views.name: v_users
views.description: Safe view of all registered SaaS user accounts. Sensitive PII columns ('email' and 'full_name') are intentionally excluded for compliance and privacy.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for each registered user. Serves as primary key.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Can be NULL if not provided during registration.

columns.name: signup_date
columns.description: Timestamp with timezone recording when the user registered.

columns.name: plan
columns.description: The initial plan selected at registration: 'starter', 'pro', or 'enterprise'.

columns.name: is_test_account
columns.description: CRITICAL: Boolean flag marking internal test/staging accounts. MUST be filtered out (is_test_account = FALSE) for all business metrics, revenue, and active user analytics.

views.name: v_subscriptions
views.description: Customer recurring subscription contracts, lifecycle statuses, and trial periods.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique subscription contract identifier (UUID).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking subscription to v_users.id.

columns.name: plan
columns.description: Contract tier: 'starter' ($29/mo), 'pro' ($99/mo), 'enterprise' ($499/mo). Used to compute MRR.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status: 'active' (currently paying), 'canceled' (churned), or 'trialing' (free trial).

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Start timestamp of the subscription contract.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Cancellation timestamp for churned subscriptions. NULL for actively running subscriptions.

columns.name: trial_end_date
columns.description: Timestamp when the 14-day free trial concluded.

views.name: v_payments
views.description: Financial ledger of all billed credit card transactions, currencies, charges, and refunds.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique transaction charge identifier (UUID).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking payment to v_users.id.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Gross billed transaction amount. Never use floating point.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: CRITICAL: Multi-currency column ('USD' vs 'EUR'). NEVER sum amounts without filtering or grouping by currency.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Payment outcome: 'succeeded' (collected revenue), 'failed' (declined), or 'refunded'.

columns.name: paid_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the payment was settled.

columns.name: refunded_amount
columns.description: Amount refunded to customer. Net Revenue = SUM(amount - COALESCE(refunded_amount, 0)) for succeeded charges.

views.name: v_events
views.description: Product telemetry and behavioral event stream tracking user engagement (100,000 rows).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique event tracking ID.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking event to v_users.id.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: Intentional actions: 'dashboard_viewed', 'query_executed', 'report_exported'. Passive actions: 'page_view', 'settings_updated'.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user took the action.

columns.name: properties
columns.description: JSON metadata. For 'query_executed', contains execution_ms. For 'report_exported', contains format.
